457-the-price-she-paid.title: The Price She Paid
457-the-price-she-paid.creator: David Graham Phillips
457-the-price-she-paid.description: A book by David Graham Phillips. Gower the younger wept; and Mildred turned away to hide the emotion distorting her face; and Frank stared gloomily at the carpet and sighed. The hideous secret of the life of duplicity was safe, safe forever.

74182-the-triumph-of-the-innocents.title: The Triumph Of The Innocents
74182-the-triumph-of-the-innocents.creator: Unknown
74182-the-triumph-of-the-innocents.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Conscious of the divine mercy, the heart of Mary rejoicing over her rescued son, feels compassion for the murdered Innocents, and for the childless mothers less happy and less honoured than herself. It is at this moment when the Virgin has been replacing the garments in which the infant had been hurriedly wrapped at the time of the escape from Bethlehem, that Jesus recognises the spirits of the slain Innocents, His little neighbours of Bethlehem, children like Himself.

arxiv-2107-03429.title: New leptons with exotic decays: collider limits and dark matter complementarity
arxiv-2107-03429.creator: Guilherme Guedes, and José Santiago
arxiv-2107-03429.description: Abstract We describe current and future hadron collider limits on new vector-like leptons with exotic decays. We consider the possibility that, besides standard decays, the new leptons can also decay into a Standard Model charged lepton and a stable particle like a dark photon.

arxiv-2111-09989.title: Sequential anomaly detection under sampling constraints Georgios Fellouris is with the Department of Statistics, the Electrical and Computer Engineering Department, and the Coordinated Science Laboratory, University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign, Champaign, IL 61820 USA, (e-mail: fellouri@illinois
arxiv-2111-09989.creator: Aristomenis Tsopelakos, Georgios Fellouris, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2111-09989.description: Abstract The problem of sequential anomaly detection is considered, where multiple data sources are monitored in real time and the goal is to identify the “anomalous” ones among them, when it is not possible to sample all sources at all times.

arxiv-2201-03037.title: On the mean radius of quasiconformal mappings
arxiv-2201-03037.creator: Alastair N. Fletcher, Jacob Pratscher
arxiv-2201-03037.description: Abstract . We study the mean radius growth function for quasiconformal mappings. We give a new sub-class of quasiconformal mappings in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} , for n ≥ 2 n\geq 2 , called bounded integrable parameterization mappings, or BIP maps for short.

arxiv-2211-00783.title: Impact Of Missing Data Imputation On The Fairness And Accuracy Of Graph Node Classifiers 2022 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (Big Data) | 978-1-6654-8045-1/22/$31.00 ©2022 European Union
arxiv-2211-00783.creator: Haris Mansoor ∗1 , Sarwan Ali ∗2 , Shafiq Alam 3 , Muhammad Asad Khan 4 , Umair ul Hassan 5 , Imdadullah Khan 1+
arxiv-2211-00783.description: Abstract Analysis of the fairness of machine learning (ML) algorithms recently attracted many researchers’ interest. Most ML methods show bias toward protected groups, which limits the applicability of ML models in many applications like crime rate prediction etc. Since the data may have missing values which, if not appropriately handled, are known to further harmfully affect fairness.

arxiv-2307-14456.title: AutoSourceID-Classifier Star-Galaxy Classification using a Convolutional Neural Network with Spatial Information
arxiv-2307-14456.creator: F. Stoppa 1,6 , S. Bhattacharyya 2 , R. Ruiz de Austri 5 , P. Vreeswijk 1 , S. Caron 3,4 , G. Zaharijas 2,9 , S. Bloemen 1 , G. Principe 12,13 , D. Malyshev 14 , V. Vodeb 2 , P.J. Groot 1,10,11 , E. Cator 6 , G. Nelemans 1,7,8
arxiv-2307-14456.description: Abstract Aims. Traditional star-galaxy classification techniques often rely on feature estimation from catalogues, a process susceptible to introducing inaccuracies, thereby potentially jeopardizing the classification’s reliability. Certain galaxies, especially those not manifesting as extended sources, can be misclassified when their shape parameters and flux solely drive the inference.

arxiv-2401-06090.title: 2D Li + ionic hopping in Li 3 InCl 6 as revealed by diffusion-induced nuclear spin relaxation
arxiv-2401-06090.creator: Florian Stainer, H. Martin R. Wilkening
arxiv-2401-06090.description: Abstract Ternary Li halides, such as Li 3 MeX 6 with, e.g. , Me = In, Sc, Y and X = Cl, Br, are in the center of attention for battery applications as these materials might serve as ionic electrolytes. To fulfill their function, such electrolytes must have an extraordinarily high ionic Li + conductivity.

arxiv-2410-14576.title: Idempotents of ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n}
arxiv-2410-14576.creator: Suman Mondal, Dhiren Kumar Basnet
arxiv-2410-14576.description: Abstract . We know that if there are k k distinct prime factors of n ∈ ℕ n\in\mathbb{N} , then the ring ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n} of integers modulo n n has exactly 2 k 2^{k} idempotent elements. In this article, we try to describe all the idempotents of ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n} for any given n ∈ ℕ n\in\mathbb{N} .

arxiv-2502-07983.title: Welzijn.AI: Developing Responsible Conversational AI for Elderly Care through Stakeholder Involvement Journal: Maturitas
arxiv-2502-07983.creator: Bram M.A. van Dijk, Armel E.J.L. Lefebvre, Marco R. Spruit
arxiv-2502-07983.description: Abstract Objectives We present Welzijn.AI as new digital solution for monitoring (mental) well-being in elderly populations, and illustrate how development of systems like Welzijn.AI can align with guidelines on responsible AI development. Study design Three evaluations with different stakeholders were designed to disclose new perspectives on the strengths, weaknesses, design characteristics, and value requirements of Welzijn.AI .

arxiv-2503-19426.title: DeCAP: Context-Adaptive Prompt Generation for Debiasing Zero-shot Question Answering in Large Language Models
arxiv-2503-19426.creator: Suyoung Bae, YunSeok Choi *, Jee-Hyong Lee *
arxiv-2503-19426.description: Abstract While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in zero-shot Question Answering (QA), they tend to expose biases in their internal knowledge when faced with socially sensitive questions, leading to a degradation in performance. Existing zero-shot methods are efficient but fail to consider context and prevent bias propagation in the answers.

arxiv-2504-16121.title: LegalRAG: A Hybrid RAG System for Multilingual Legal Information Retrieval
arxiv-2504-16121.creator: Muhammad Rafsan Kabir 1 * , Rafeed Mohammad Sultan 1 * , Fuad Rahman 2 , Mohammad Ruhul Amin 3 , Sifat Momen 1 , Nabeel Mohammed 1 , Shafin Rahman 1
arxiv-2504-16121.description: Abstract Natural Language Processing (NLP) and computational linguistic techniques are increasingly being applied across various domains, yet their use in legal and regulatory tasks remains limited. To address this gap, we develop an efficient bilingual question-answering framework for regulatory documents, specifically the Bangladesh Police Gazettes, which contain both English and Bangla text.

pmc-11467194.title: Human health risk assessment of potentially toxic and essential elements in medicinal plants consumed in Zabol, Iran, using the Monte Carlo simulation method
pmc-11467194.creator: Gholamreza Ebrahimzadeh, Abdullah Khalid Omer, Maziar Naderi, Kiomars Sharafi
pmc-11467194.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Medicinal plants (MPs) have long been used for their therapeutic properties in traditional forms of medicine. However, the presence of potentially toxic elements (PTEs) in MPs raises concerns about their safety, efficacy, and potential adverse effects on human health. The current study aimed to determine the level of potentially toxic and essential elements (PTEEs) in commonly consumed MPs in Zabol, Iran, along with their health risk assessments.

pmc-11655593.title: Phenylmercury stress induces root tip swelling through auxin homeostasis disruption
pmc-11655593.creator: Shimpei Uraguchi, Masakazu Sato, Chihiro Hagai, Momoko Hirakawa, Kotomi Ogawa, Miyu Odagiri, Haruka Sato, Ayaka Ohmori, Yuka Ohshiro, Ryosuke Nakamura, Yasukazu Takanezawa, Masako Kiyono
pmc-11655593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We previously reported that in Arabidopsis, the phytochelatin-mediated metal-detoxification machinery is also essential for organomercurial phenylmercury (PheHg) tolerance. PheHg treatment causes severe root growth inhibition in cad1-3, an Arabidopsis phytochelatin-deficient mutant, frequently accompanied by abnormal root tip swelling. Here, we examine morphological and physiological characteristics of PheHg-induced abnormal root tip swelling in comparison to Hg(II) stress and demonstrate that auxin homeostasis disorder in the root is associated with the PheHg-induced root tip swelling.

pmc-12372679.description: Teaching point: Gallbladder volvulus is a rare but serious diagnosis that needs urgent surgical treatment to avoid morbidity and mortality related to gallbladder ischemia and should be suspected in elderly female patients with acute right upper quadrant pain with imaging features including enlarged, abnormally positioned gallbladder and specific key findings on CT including “whirl sign” representing twisting of the cystic

pmc-12537362.title: Preprocedural computed tomography angiography-guided transcatheter arterial embolization for managing esophageal cancer bleeding: a case series study
pmc-12537362.creator: Xue-Jiao Yang, Yong-Juan Wu, Jing-Zhong Wang, Yu-Lan Zheng, Guang-Yuan Cheng, Yun-Hua Cui, Xiao-Qi Li
pmc-12537362.description: ObjectiveWhile endoscopy is the first-line treatment for non-variceal upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage, its role in managing upper gastrointestinal tumor bleeding is limited. This study aims to evaluate the effect of computed tomography angiography (CTA)-guided transcatheter arterial embolization (TAE) in achieving hemostasis for esophageal cancer bleeding.

pmc-12571188.title: The Role of C/EBP‐Homologous Protein in Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathies
pmc-12571188.creator: Monica Sciacco, Patrizia Ciscato, Letizia Bertolasi, Maria Guttuso, Stefania Corti, Deborah Mattinzoli, Masami Ikeata, Giuseppe Castellano, Giacomo Pietro Comi, Simona Zanotti
pmc-12571188.description: The Idiopathic Inflammatory Myopathies (IIMs) are a group of autoimmune disorders characterised by persistent muscle inflammation and diverse clinical manifestations. Common symptoms include muscle weakness, myalgia, and elevated serum creatine kinase levels. Recent findings highlight the relevance of muscle fibre necrosis in IIMs. We therefore grouped our IIM patients according to the percentage of necrotic fibres in muscle biopsy.

pmc-12588276.title: From breaking rules to making rules in materials science
pmc-12588276.creator: Bharat Jalan
pmc-12588276.description: s later, as a student of metallurgical and materials engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras, I learned the formal mantra: structure and bonding control properties. It was a powerful truth, but it sparked a bigger question in me: Who controls structure and bonding? My professors would point to thermodynamics as the ultimate authority.

pmc-12790208.title: Social Determinants of Cardiovascular Health in the Irish Traveller at Individual, Interpersonal, Community, and Societal Levels
pmc-12790208.creator: Bandar Alhaidari, Frances Meagher, Michael J Daly
pmc-12790208.description: Social determinants, such as economic, cultural, and racial factors, are significant contributors to health disparities among patients with cardiovascular disease, particularly in disadvantaged populations. This report outlines the strategies taken at a single institution to educate medical students about the social determinants that affect the health care needs of the Irish Traveller community.

pmc-13339378.title: Extraction, structural characterization and SNP identification of related genes of collagen from local pigs in Guizhou
pmc-13339378.creator: Yu Dan Zhang, Xiao Yang, Wei Xia, Ying Qu Liu, Yi Yu Zhang, Wei Chen
pmc-13339378.description: BackgroundCollagen, as one of the important components of living organisms, plays a crucial role in supporting and maintaining tissue structure and biological functions. The local pig breed in Guizhou is renowned for its elastic skin, tender meat, and excellent taste. The collagen content in pig skin accounts for approximately 87.7% of the protein content.

pmc-13380226.title: Sinking city: A multidimensional dataset for urban and land subsidence modelling based on satellite imagery in Jakarta, Indonesia (2016-2024)
pmc-13380226.creator: Zahratu Shabrina, Fajrun Wahidil Muharram, Muhammad Asa, Dekka Dhirgantara Putra, Jin Rui
pmc-13380226.description: Jakarta, the world’s fastest-sinking city, faces complex urban challenges from the complexity of its urban morphology, infrastructure, and environmental conditions. This study presents a descriptor for a multidimensional database of Jakarta, Indonesia, that can be used to analyse the city’s subsidence and understand the frequent flooding events throughout the city.

pmc-13420647.title: AI-Driven Heart Failure Decision Support in Skilled Nursing Facilities
pmc-13420647.creator: Emma Glajchen, Mills Reed, Takeshi Uemura, Johanna Contreras, Zoe Ozols, Annapoorna S Kini, Jeffrey Bander
pmc-13420647.description: Heart failure management in skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) is complicated by limited access to specialists, incomplete clinical documentation, and patients with complex comorbidities. Artificial intelligence clinical decision support systems have been developed mostly for acute hospital settings but not for SNF settings. We present ForeSight-HF, an artificial intelligence clinical decision support tool designed specifically for SNF heart failure management.

pmc-13631247.title: Unsupervised discovery of functional sequence patterns from protein language model with MotifAE
pmc-13631247.creator: Chao Hou, Di Liu, Yufeng Shen
pmc-13631247.description: Protein language models (pLMs) learn sequence patterns at evolutionary scale, but these patterns remain inaccessible within these “black box” models. To discover them, we developed MotifAE, an unsupervised framework based on the sparse autoencoder (SAE) architecture that projects pLM embeddings into an interpretable, sparse latent space.
